verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own bank and credit card reconciliation so every transaction matches the bank statement. AI Close uses agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies, which covers the core of the story. However, no evidence shows a review view that separates matched, unmatched and duplicate transactions per account. Missing for 10: documented matched/unmatched categorization, duplicate-transaction detection, a per-account review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
